title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the acceleration as 2.7 m/s² using the kinematic equation for uniformly accelerated motion.

title: Centripetal acceleration ratio
description: Essential: The response must correctly derive and state the ratio of centripetal accelerations as 225/242.

title: Correct exit identification
description: Essential: The response must correctly identify athlete A as the one who exits the curve first.

title: Application of kinematic equation
description: Important: The solution must apply the correct kinematic equation (v² = u² + 2as) for the rectilinear motion, with u=0.

title: Centripetal acceleration formula
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the formula a_c = v²/R to find the accelerations or their ratio.

title: Time calculation for semicircle
description: Important: The reasoning must include calculating the time for each athlete using t = πR/v for the semicircular path.

title: Comparison logic
description: Optional: The response may explicitly compare the calculated times (4π/5 s vs. 9π/11 s) to justify the conclusion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution may demonstrate consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculations.

title: Incorrect kinematic equation
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect kinematic equation (e.g., v = u + at) without considering the given distance, leading to a wrong acceleration.

title: Ratio inversion error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly inverting the ratio of centripetal accelerations (e.g., writing 242/225) or misapplying the formula a_c ∝ v²/R.
